earlierPasses.why: stuck: A backpack of 20+ miles with no single trailhead for 'west slope from Black Giant Pass'. Candidates: South Lake via Bishop Pass and Le Conte Canyon to the JMT a
earlierPasses.notes: A backpack of 20+ miles with no single trailhead for 'west slope from Black Giant Pass'. Candidates: South Lake via Bishop Pass and Le Conte Canyon to the JMT and Muir Pass (USFS South Lake Trailhead 37.169305,-118.565813), Sabrina via Echo Col (the east variant the route text itself says adds class 3), or North Lake/Piute Pass. The only page about this pass I could open (climber.org 2006/1514) starts at Sabrina, i.e. the east variant. Route name and text put the line on the JMT side, which favours South Lake, but no page states it. Not guessed. Highsierratopix gave 403; Summitpost 403. Route reaches summit per its own text.

priorPass.why: climber.org 2006/1514 (opened) starts at Sabrina Lake via Echo Col, the east variant. West Slope probably South Lake via Bishop Pass/JMT but no page says so.
